description: List Google Drive files matching a Drive search query (for example "name contains 'budget' and mimeType='application/pdf'"), newest first. Returns id, name, mime type, modified time, and size per file. Requires a connected account (run connect_account first).
embedding_description: Search the connected Google Drive and return matching file descriptors. Accepts a Drive query using Drive's search grammar (name contains, mimeType, modifiedTime, trashed, parents in folder). Returns a list of files with id, name, mimeType, modifiedTime and size, ordered newest first, plus a count. Pair with drive_download_file to fetch a binary file's bytes. Fails gsuite.not_connected if no account is linked.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a files list ({id, name, mime, modified, size}) and a count.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize how many files matched and list a few by name. Suggest drive_download_file with an id to fetch a binary file. File names may reveal content — treat as moderately sensitive.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List Google Drive files matching a search query.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.auth_expired: the refresh token was revoked. gsuite.rate_limited: Google throttled the request.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.not_connected / gsuite.auth_expired: run connect_account. gsuite.rate_limited: back off and retry.
